about: Camera presets (BSD-3-Clause). A preset writes these values into the camera options (CamParam_*); every value stays editable afterwards. qeCurve: an FPbase QE spectrum id (curve in fpbase_spectra.json, CC BY-SA 4.0) used as QE(lambda) in the detected-fraction integral, or 'Flat' = the scalar quantumEfficiency at every wavelength. physicalPixelUm is informational (the sample pixel size stays General_PixelSizeNm).

presets.name: Teledyne Photometrics Kinetix22 (sCMOS, sensitivity mode)
presets.notes: Today's (pre-issue-16) adapter defaults. The per-pixel spreads (gain 0.5 %, read noise 20 %) are estimates: Photometrics does not publish them.

presets.name: Andor iXon Ultra 897 (EMCCD, 512 x 512, back-illuminated)
presets.notes: Typical published values: read noise of the EM amplifier before gain (~50 e- at 10 MHz; under 1 e- effective at EM gain 300), CIC ~0.005 e-/px/frame, dark current 0.00025 e-/px/s at -80 C, ~4 e-/ADU pre-amplifier setting. QE curve: FPbase 'Andor iXon 897 BV, BVF'. Not re-checked against the current datasheet.
